events.title: Carnaval de Barranquilla 2027
events.summary: The official Carnival site lists the 2027 main Carnival days as February 6–9, covering Saturday through Tuesday of Carnival. Though based in Barranquilla, it is the Caribbean coast’s flagship music-and-dance carnival and a major side trip from Cartagena.

events.title: Fiesta de Nuestra Señora de La Candelaria
events.venueName: Convento de Santa Cruz de la Popa / Cartagena citywide
events.summary: Cartagena’s patron-saint celebration falls on February 2 and is traditionally marked with processions, community festivities, cumbia, gaitas and dance around La Popa and the city.
